title: Issue #4257 fix
intent:
Current state: #4257 root cause pinned by in-process measurement on the real home (278 worktree rows). read_managed_hook_health cost 219ms/row (61s per projection build) because expected_hook_bin_for_config_path spawned `git ls-files --error-unmatch` for every hook config of every Work row, on the GUI event loop, even when no expected hook binary is configured (the GUI never sets GWT_HOOK_BIN, so the answer was discarded). hidden_command spawns are not in the process summary log, which is why the stalls looked silent. diagnose_for_projection is only 16ms/row.

Decision: skip the spawn when no expected binary is configured (behavior-identical, one early return) instead of a background projection builder. It removes the dominant cost for every full-build caller (Board milestone, Work scan results, RuntimeHook, LaunchComplete). Debug build: 219ms/row -> 115ms/row; the remainder is re-parsing the 121KB home discussions.md per row (release measurement running). Also fixed AC-2: pane_backend_unresponsive no longer claims 'saturated instance'.

Next: release before/after numbers, scoped verify.run, Draft PR.
